description: TRAI says the SIM will be disconnected for illegal ads, hands over to 'cyber police', demands a refundable deposit.

events.text: This is the Telecom Authority. Your mobile number will be disconnected in two hours because it was used for illegal advertisement and harassing calls.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: I am connecting you to the Mumbai cyber police officer. Please do not disconnect, the matter is sensitive and you should not discuss it with anybody.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: To avoid legal action you must deposit a refundable security amount of twenty five thousand rupees, it will be returned after verification.
events.speaker: caller
